segments.text: GRaunt almighty God, ſeing thou wilt haue vs to differ from the brute beaſtes, and therefore haſt grafted in our hartes the light of vnderſtanding: that we may learne to know this to be thy ſingular grace and gift, and that we may reuerence and magnify thee for the ſame, and that we may alwayes exerciſe our ſelues in the knowledge of thoſe thinges which may bring vs reuerently to regard thy word and thy maieſty: and alſo that we may put ſuch difference betwixt the commō ſenſe that thou haſt geuen vs, and the light of thy ſpirite, that thou mayſt be glorified: and that we may alwayes eſpecially praiſe thee for thy gift of faith, wherby we are made thy childrē engrafted into the body of thy ſonne, and that we may continually craue encreaſe of the ſame fayth of thee, whiles in the end thou do bring vs to that full reuelation of light, when we being made like thee, ſhall beholde thy glory face to face, and ſhall haue the fruition therof, through the ſame our Lord Ieſus Chriſt. Amen.
